oldmc.option.percentage.tooltip: Show the world loading percentage above the chunk grid and hide the progress bar.
oldmc.option.grid.tooltip: Use the default 29×29 chunk grid from 1.21.8.
oldmc.option.debug.tooltip: Restore the F3 layout from Minecraft 1.21.8 and earlier.
oldmc.option.version.tooltip: Display classic version numbers in the client. Server connections use the actual game version.
oldmc.option.versionFormat.tooltip:
Major update format follows Minecraft’s earlier numbering: 26.1 becomes 1.22, 26.1.x becomes 1.22.x, and 26.2 becomes 1.23.
Year-based update format counts each update in order: 26.1 becomes 1.26, 26.1.1 becomes 1.26.1, 26.1.2 becomes 1.26.2, and 26.2 becomes 1.26.3.
Requires “Classic version numbers”.
oldmc.option.dirtBackground.tooltip: Restore the dirt background from Minecraft 1.20.4 and earlier.
oldmc.versionFormat.name: Version number format
oldmc.option.pauseMenuText.tooltip: Show the pause menu icon row as text buttons.
oldmc.option.friendButtonPlacement.toolt:
Set the position of the Friends button on the pause menu.
“Full row” and “Replace Report Bugs” require “Text-only pause menu buttons”.
oldmc.option.removeFeedback.tooltip: Remove both buttons from the pause menu.
oldmc.option.removePlayerReporting.toolt: Remove the “Player Reporting” button from the pause menu.
oldmc.option.titleSideButtons: Restore classic title screen button layout
oldmc.option.titleSideButtons.tooltip: Place Language to the left of Options and Accessibility to the right of Quit Game, as in 26.1.
Choose where the Friends button appears on the title screen, or hide it.
Requires “Restore classic title screen button layout”.
